scope: Console navigation over the F05.1 directories with today's bearer-token sign-in. Institutional sign-in, sessions and expiry are F04.3; choosing people and recipients is F05.3.

commands.detail: ui summary 30/30 (10 specimens x 3 viewports, new 'project' specimen); behaviour 0 failures including probes 76-81; seven v4f regressions still reproduced
10 scenarios plus PostgreSQL persistence after browser/server shutdown

acceptance.1 navigate login > labs/projects > datas: Met for token sign-in. Real PostgreSQL: after an operator bootstrap the owner opens 'Legacy migration lab' > project > 'Console rehearsal n-back pilot' (server-side search) and lands on the release; crumbs name project and label. URLs are #/l/{lab}, #/p/{project}[?q=], #/d/{dataset}; a #/d deep link survives sign-in. Institutional login itself is not built (F04.3).
acceptance.2 no memberships, empty projects, expire: Met except expired institutional sessions (F04.3; a revoked/expired token still returns to sign-in as before). Real PostgreSQL: grant-only colleague sees 'Nothing to show yet' and a denied project link. Demo probes: empty project, denied link (uniform 'Nothing here', back link), stale paging (409 restart with notice), no organization (409/404 falls back to the identifier form), operational errors offer Try again.
acceptance.3 keyboard/focus, responsive, production: Met. Probe 77 navigates home > project > dataset with Enter only; Show more moves focus to the first new row; search keeps focus in its box. 390 px specimens pass with no horizontal overflow and axe. The console calls only /v1 directory, lab and project routes; places remembered for crumbs are display-only and cleared on sign-out.

negativeCases: colleague without Discover sees no directory rows (PostgreSQL)
cursor invalidated mid-listing: restart from page one
invalid dataset identifier refused before any request
limitations: Sign-in is still a pasted bearer token; F04.3 replaces the form only.
Crumb names come from directories this tab has shown. A dataset opened directly by URL in a fresh tab shows its identifier, since placement is steward-only.
Home loads at most five pages of 100 per directory and says so when truncated; lab pages do not search.
Labels exist only where stewards set them; unlabelled datasets show 'Unlabelled dataset' and a short id.
Shares appear only for grants that include Discover; grants made from the console Access page do not yet offer Discover (F05.3).
Demo-transport probes do not qualify scale or query plans (H04).
